subtitles, captions, closed captions, burned-in subtitles, lower thirds, black subtitle box, text overlay, dialogue written on screen, random letters, random words, numbers, interface graphics, watermark, film grain, analog grain, digital noise, colored speckles, black speckles, pixel blocks, square artifacts, compression artifacts, flicker, dirty image, oversharpening, heavy motion blur, deformed hands, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, duplicated fingers, fingers merged with hair, hair passing through fingers, unstable grip, distorted hair dryer, broken hair dryer, duplicated hair dryer, face distortion, identity drift, blurry eyes, eye flicker, warped mouth, distorted teeth, duplicate body, camera shake, sudden zoom, framing jump, scene change, large body movement, violent hair movement, instant hair transformation, background music, multiple voices, robotic voice, distorted speech, loose cable, dangling cable, visible wire, stray black line, rope, string, object held in empty hands, object appearing from bottom edge, cable crossing the white dress, dryer cord visible before the third shot

The shot begins immediately on the dry frizzy result. The woman faces the camera in a stable medium shot. Her very long brown-blonde hair is fully dry, visibly expanded, rough, and frizzy around the mid-lengths and ends, matching the reference image. Her eyebrows lift and her eyes widen slightly as she recognizes the problem. Both hands remain below chest level and mostly still; she does not pinch, pull, separate, or lift individual hair strands. She speaks in a warm natural Brazilian Portuguese voice: "Molhado fica lindo. Secou? Frizz!" The voice is clear and close, with a brief natural pause between the two phrases. | The same woman appears with freshly washed wet hair in the same bathroom and framing. The damp strands hang downward in stable natural groups and look relatively controlled. She looks at the camera with a calm, matter-of-fact expression.

Both hands are fully visible, completely empty, relaxed, and naturally open near the sides of her waist. Her fingers remain separated and anatomically correct. She does not hold, pinch, pull, squeeze, twist, or touch any object. She does not hold any cable, cord, wire, rope, black line, hair strand, tool, accessory, or hair dryer. Nothing extends upward from the bottom edge of the frame. No object may appear between her fingers or across her dress. Only a slight head tilt and natural mouth movement occur.

She says in the same warm Brazilian Portuguese voice: "Depois de lavar, parecia tudo certo." The delivery is calm and conversational. | The same woman holds a complete black hair dryer correctly by its handle in her right hand. The dryer body, nozzle, and handle remain stable and correctly connected. The power cord stays completely outside the visible frame and must not appear. The nozzle points toward the outer side of her damp hair and stays away from her face. Her left hand rests naturally near her waist and does not touch the hair. The airflow creates only subtle movement in the outer strands; do not perform a complete wet-to-dry transformation. She glances briefly toward the hair and then back to the camera with mild disappointment. She says in the same warm Brazilian Portuguese voice: "Com o secador, ficava seco e armado." Her mouth moves naturally in approximate synchronization while the hands and hair dryer remain stable.

properties.global_prompt: Create one clean 9-second vertical 9:16 natural haircare testimonial composed of three consecutive 3-second shots. The exact same adult Brazilian woman appears in all three shots in the same modern light-marble bathroom, wearing the same fitted sleeveless white dress. Preserve her facial identity, skin tone, hairstyle base, hair length, bathroom architecture, lighting direction, camera height, and medium framing. The visual style is clean modern digital beauty photography with smooth tonal transitions, natural skin texture, clear hair strands, neutral warm bathroom light, and a stable camera. Her movements remain small and controlled. She speaks in native Brazilian Portuguese with one consistent warm adult Brazilian female voice, clear dry speech, a calm conversational pace, and no background music. Her lips move naturally in approximate synchronization with the speech; exact phoneme-level lip matching is not required. The first shot shows the dry frizzy result, the second shot shows freshly washed wet hair with both hands completely empty, and the third shot shows her using a black hair dryer while noticing the hair becoming difficult to manage. No loose cable, cord, wire, rope, strand, or black line may appear in the second shot. Keep the performance realistic and restrained.
